def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(value for value in Counter(value for row in grid for value in row) if value not in (0, background))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in points]
    height = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    width = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    for r in range(len(grid) - height + 1):

            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
